I picked both Design and Reference under "Label is," left it on "Match any selected," and got the two bookmarks — the one tagged Design and the one tagged Reference — while the Books one stayed out. So I can now gather things that match *either* of a couple of labels, not only ones that satisfy everything at once, and it's reassuring that I can still layer an exact phrase or a site-exclusion on top to tighten that combined group further. That's the either/or piece I wanted, and it completes the sharper searching for me. The finding side feels whole now.
